source_text: Confitebitur peccatum; offeret feminam de grege. Confessio praecedit munus. Christus agnus; anima paenitens ovis.
pass_a_gloss: He-will-confess sin; he-will-offer female from flock. Confession precedes gift. Christ lamb; soul penitent sheep.
pass_b_english: He shall [[confess the sin and bring a female from the flock >> Bible:Leviticus 5:5-6]]. Confession goes before the gift. Christ is the Lamb; the penitent soul is the sheep.
